analysis.purpose: The test suite for cli — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: crib context --package (WS-4 bulk dossierByScope) — CLI dispatch; read commands use an existing derived index instead of rebuilding it; crib index --crib-dir; crib index <archive> — archive identity round-trip.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of cli
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
